CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The trial was a dose-escalation safety study with DLT as primary endpoint. One DLT occurred at 1.8 mg/kg (1/12 subjects), but the trial continued to higher doses (2.4 mg/kg) without additional DLTs. However, no complete or partial responses were observed in any dose cohort for the secondary efficacy endpoint (BOR). The trial was terminated early due to sponsor decision to discontinue the NHS-IL2 program. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. All dose cohorts showed zero efficacy responses. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a small Phase I study (n=12) primarily designed for safety, not efficacy. Early termination was due to commercial decision rather than safety concerns, as higher doses were tolerated. The lack of any responses across all dose levels suggests either insufficient target engagement or ineffective mechanism.
